subject: SolidGeometry
question:
A solid is formed by stacking $14$ cubes, each with an edge of $1$ meter, on the ground as shown. Its exposed surface is painted. What area, in square meters, is painted?
<image1>
original_question:
An artist has $14$ cubes, each with an edge of $1$ meter.  She stands them on the ground to form a sculpture as shown.  She then paints the exposed surface of the sculpture.  How many square meters does she paint?
<image1>
